narrative.overview: The familiar agent dev-tool landing frame: centered hero with install and demo, a Works with row, alternating feature blocks, cards, FAQ, closing install. Three voices on flat paper with one ink and one orange: thick human headings in Mona Sans wide and heavy; squared technical accents in Chakra Petch 600 orange, which drop signal in the hero; thin, rigid JetBrains Mono 300 for what a machine prints.
keyCharacteristics: Thick human voice (Mona Sans wide, heavy) for every heading.
Squared accent voice (Chakra Petch 600, orange) for technical nouns and claim tails.
Thin machine voice (JetBrains Mono 300) for commands, ids and readouts.
The hero's accent words glitch on their own clocks, drifting in and out of phase; static under reduced motion.
Variable-axis type does the work that cards, icons and color do elsewhere.
Flat everywhere: hairlines and tonal sheets, no shadows.
One accent, used large and nowhere small.
Mono is for commands, ids and readouts only.
Light and dark are the same system on warm paper / warm ink.

rules.name: The Thick/Thin Rule
rules.body: Human copy is thick (Mona Sans 800 wide); technical type is thin (Chakra Petch 600 for accents, JetBrains Mono 300 for machine text). Never thicken the technical voices to match the headline.

rules.name: The Fitted Part Rule
rules.body: Inside a heading, only the technical noun or the claim's last words change voice, and only to the accent. One accent run per heading line, never mid-word, never a third family.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange appears on large marks or not at all; small text that needs orange uses accent-text.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces differ by one tonal step separated by hairlines. No gradients, no tinted backdrops.

rules.name: The Axis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis in human copy is a change of wdth/wght; the only change of family is the Accent voice, and never italic.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Mono only for things a machine prints or a human types.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers in readouts and results are tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is hairline plus one tonal step.

dos: Do keep orange to large marks; use accent-text #b8360a for any small orange.
Do separate with 1px hairlines and one tonal step; keep every sheet at 6px radius.
Do set commands, ids and readouts in mono at 11px / 12.5px with tabular-nums.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion state.
Do keep claims in captions exact and dated.
Do put a heading's technical noun or claim tail in the Accent voice with accent-voice, never an inline font family.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glow or backdrop blur.
Don't add icon-card grids, a dark terminal hero, or a second accent hue.
Don't set sentences in mono or emphasize with italics or color.
Don't use Lease Green outside docs success states.
Don't let orange carry small text or meaning on its own.
Don't add a stroke or faux-bold to the accent words, or set them in mono.
Don't glitch anything outside the hero's two accent words.
